Context: 1. Immediate relief to the family of an employee who dies while in service

7. Adjustment of the Advance.The advance should be adjusted within six months against the arrears of pay and allowances, leave salary, death gratuity, balance in Contributory / General Provident Fund or any other payment due in respect of the deceased official.
- Appendix-2, Pension Compilation.
